remarks: This glorious Tudor style townhome condominium screams of taste and charm as you pass the mansion next door on your drive up, entering this dramatic sun-filled condo. 668 Glenbrook has impressive water views from both the private balcony and the primary bedroom. Equally impressive in size and feel, with soaring vaulted ceilings, a skylight, a stunning fireplace, a modernized kitchen, powder room, and a large primary bath. Take long walks along the water with your pet in this pet-friendly complex. Number 25 is just a short walk away from the Glenbrook Train Station and also close to 95 and the Merritt Parkway. Stamford will offer you the best of waterfront dining, shopping, and a vibrant city feel all while living in quiet charm. DON'T MISS THE MASSIVE LOWER LEVEL PRIVATE ROOM FOR STORAGE BELOW THE UNIT!
